name: lost-found-assistant
description: Conversational lost-and-found agent: registers found items, matches lost reports, and verifies ownership with hidden-feature questions.

displayDescription.en: Handles found-item registration, lost-item matching and claim verification through conversation, protecting owners' privacy with hidden-feature checks.
displayDescription.zh: 通过对话完成拾物登记、寻物匹配与认领核验，靠隐藏特征核验防冒领，全程保护失主隐私信息。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I found a pair of black earphones on the playground and want to register it
